review: 702.37e-1: forge_notes claimed the enters-the-battlefield clause of 702.37e cannot be exercised; it can, through a permanent that triggers on creatures entering. Rewrote the note.
702.37e-2: added a scenario with Soul Warden showing that turning a permanent face up does not trigger enters abilities, against casting a face-down card that does enter.

scenarios.title: A card cast with morph is a 2/2 face-down creature paid for with {3}
decisions: A casts Daru Lancer face down using its morph ability, paying {3} with the three Plains.
Both players pass; the face-down spell resolves.

variants.label: three_lands
variants.expected: Daru Lancer enters the battlefield face down as a 2/2 creature with no name, no abilities (no first strike), no subtypes and no mana cost. All three Plains are tapped.

variants.label: two_lands
variants.delta: A controls two Plains instead of three.
variants.expected: The face-down cast is not possible because {3} cannot be paid. Daru Lancer stays in A's hand and nothing is put on the stack.

scenarios.title: A card can be cast face down only if it has a morph ability
decisions: A attempts to cast the card in hand face down, paying {3} with the three Plains.

variants.label: has_morph
variants.expected: Casting Daru Lancer face down is legal (can_play true).

variants.label: no_morph
variants.delta: The card in A's hand is Savannah Lions, which has no morph ability.
variants.expected: Casting Savannah Lions face down is not legal; it offers only the face-up cast for {W}.

scenarios.title: A megamorph permanent turned face up gets a +1/+1 counter and a plain morph does not
decisions: A turns Aerie Bowmasters face up as a special action, paying its megamorph cost {5}{G} with all six lands.

variants.label: megamorph
variants.expected: Aerie Bowmasters is face up with one +1/+1 counter, a 4/5 with reach. All six lands are tapped.

variants.label: plain_morph
variants.delta: The face-down permanent is Daru Lancer, which A turns face up paying its morph cost {2}{W}{W} with both Plains and two Forests.
variants.expected: Daru Lancer is face up as a 3/4 with first strike and no counters. Two Forests stay untapped.

scenarios.forge_notes: The face-down permanent is placed directly on the battlefield by the harness.

scenarios.title: Turning a face-down permanent face up is a special action that does not use the stack
decisions: B has cast Shock targeting A's face-down creature, tapping Mountain; it is on the stack and A has priority.
A turns Daru Lancer face up as a special action, paying {2}{W}{W} with both Plains and both Forests; Shock is still on the stack afterwards.

variants.label: flip_in_response
variants.expected: Daru Lancer is face up with its normal characteristics (3/4, first strike) while Shock is still on the stack. Shock deals 2 damage to it and it survives with 2 damage marked.

variants.label: no_flip
variants.delta: A does not turn Daru Lancer face up and just passes priority.
variants.expected: Shock deals 2 damage to the 2/2 face-down creature and it dies; Daru Lancer goes to A's graveyard face up.

variants.label: not_enough_mana
variants.delta: A controls only one Forest (three lands), so the morph cost cannot be paid.
variants.expected: The turn-face-up action is not possible; the permanent stays a face-down 2/2, Shock deals 2 damage and it dies.

scenarios.forge_notes: The enters-the-battlefield clause is exercised in 702.37e-2 through Soul Warden; Forge's morph cards with their own enters triggers (Efreet Weaponmaster, Ponyback Brigade) also trigger when turned face up, so they cannot show it.

scenarios.title: X in a morph cost is the X chosen when the permanent is turned face up
decisions: A turns Warbreak Trumpeter face up as a special action, choosing X = 2 and paying {2}{2}{R} with five Mountains.
The turned-face-up trigger goes on the stack; both players pass and it resolves.

variants.label: x_is_2
variants.expected: Two 1/1 red Goblin creature tokens are created for A. Warbreak Trumpeter is face up as a 1/1.

variants.label: x_is_1
variants.delta: A chooses X = 1 and pays {1}{1}{R}, leaving two Mountains untapped.
variants.expected: One 1/1 red Goblin creature token is created.

variants.label: x_is_0
variants.delta: A chooses X = 0 and pays only {R}.
variants.expected: No tokens are created; Warbreak Trumpeter is face up as a 1/1.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge counts the X paid through xPaid on the turn-face-up trigger; check it accepts X for a morph special action.

scenarios.title: Turning a permanent face up is not entering the battlefield, so enters triggers do not fire
decisions: A turns the face-down Daru Lancer on the battlefield face up as a special action, paying {2}{W}{W} with both Plains and both Forests.

variants.label: turned_face_up
variants.expected: Daru Lancer is face up as a 3/4 with first strike. Soul Warden's ability does not trigger; A's life stays 20.

variants.label: cast_face_down
variants.delta: Instead of turning the face-down Daru Lancer face up, A casts the Daru Lancer in hand face down for {3} with both Plains and one Forest, and it resolves.
variants.expected: A second face-down 2/2 creature enters the battlefield. Soul Warden's ability triggers and resolves; A's life is 21.

scenarios.forge_notes: Soul Warden triggers on a zone change to the battlefield; Forge's TurnFaceUp is a separate event, so it should not fire.
